note: Empirical RC4 single-byte keystream bias counts, Pr(Z_r = k). Measured offline over 2^24 random 16-byte keys. Positions r are 1-indexed (row 0 is Z_1). AlFardan, Bernstein, Paterson, Poettering and Schuldt, "On the Security of RC4 in TLS and WPA" (USENIX Security 2013), §4.1, measured there over 2^44 keys; this is a teaching-scale table.
